title: Expression, potential biological behaviour and clinical significance of MCM3 in pancreatic adenocarcinoma: a comprehensive study integrating high throughput sequencing, CRISPR screening and in-house immunohistochemistry.
authors: Chen, Yi; Li, Liu-Yan; Li, Jian-Di; He, Rong-Quan; Huang, Zhi-Guang; Huang, Wan-Ying; Luo, Jia-Yuan; Dang, Yi-Wu; Chen, Gang; Wei, Dan-Ming
one_liner_zh: 该研究整合高通量测序、CRISPR筛选和免疫组化分析MCM3在胰腺癌中的表达与临床意义，虽涉及分子对接但核心为肿瘤生物标志物研究，缺乏蛋白质-DNA互作体系与AI/物理模拟方法，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: BACKGROUND: Minichromosome maintenance complex component 3 (MCM3) plays a key role in various tumours. However, it remains largely unknown what the specific role and clinical significance of MCM3 in pancreatic adenocarcinoma (PAAD) are. MATERIALS AND METHODS: We integrated high-throughput data from PAAD worldwide to analyse the expression level of MCM3 mRNA. We used immunohistochemistry to analyse MCM3 protein expression levels in 145 cases in the PAAD group and 29 cases in the non-PAAD group. We also mainly analysed the necessity of MCM3 for PAAD growth based on CRISPR screen data. In addition, we used enrichment analysis and protein-protein interaction networks to explore the molecular mechanism of MCM3 in PAAD. We also analysed the correlation between MCM3 expression, components of the immune microenvironment in PAAD tissue and clinical prognosis. RESULTS: In PAAD, we observed for the first time that MCM3 was significantly highly expressed at both the mRNA (SMD = 0.67, 95% CI: 0.38  approximately  0.96) and the protein level (p < 0.05). The mRNA (AUC = 0.78, 95% CI: 0.74  approximately  0.81; sensitivity = 0.66, 95% CI: 0.55  approximately  0.76; specificity = 0.76, 95% CI: 0.67  approximately  0.84) and protein (AUC = 0.929) expression levels of MCM3 had a good ability to distinguish between PAAD and non-PAAD tissue. There was heterogeneity reflected by the differential expression of MCM3 protein in PAAD cells. MCM3 played an essential role in PAAD growth, through abnormal DNA replication, p53 signalling and cell cycle checkpoints. PAAD with high MCM3 expression was sensitive to c-75, brivanib, flavopiridol and VNLG/124 drugs, with stable molecular docking models. CONCLUSION: MCM3 is likely to be a critical element in promoting the initiation and growth of PAAD. Flavopiridol may exert its anti-PAAD effect through the interaction between MCM3, classic CDK1 targets in the cell cycle checkpoint and p53 pathway as well as related molecules in other pathways.
abstract_zh: 背景：微小染色体维持复合物组分3（MCM3）在多种肿瘤中发挥关键作用。然而，MCM3在胰腺腺癌（PAAD）中的具体作用和临床意义仍 largely 未知。材料与方法：我们整合了全球PAAD的高通量数据，分析MCM3 mRNA的表达水平。我们使用免疫组织化学方法分析了PAAD组145例和非PAAD组29例中MCM3蛋白的表达水平。我们还主要基于CRISPR筛选数据分析MCM3对PAAD生长的必要性。此外，我们使用富集分析和蛋白质-蛋白质相互作用网络来探索MCM3在PAAD中的分子机制。我们还分析了MCM3表达、PAAD组织中免疫微环境组分与临床预后之间的相关性。结果：在PAAD中，我们首次观察到MCM3在mRNA水平（SMD = 0.67，95% CI：0.38 约 0.96）和蛋白水平（p < 0.05）均显著高表达。MCM3的mRNA（AUC = 0.78，95% CI：0.74 约 0.81；敏感性 = 0.66，95% CI：0.55 约 0.76；特异性 = 0.76，95% CI：0.67 约 0.84）和蛋白（AUC = 0.929）表达水平具有良好的区分PAAD和非PAAD组织的能力。PAAD细胞中MCM3蛋白的差异表达反映了异质性。MCM3通过异常DNA复制、p53信号通路和细胞周期检查点在PAAD生长中发挥重要作用。高MCM3表达的PAAD对c-75、brivanib、flavopiridol和VNLG/124药物敏感，且具有稳定的分子对接模型。结论：MCM3可能是促进PAAD发生和生长的关键因素。Flavopiridol可能通过MCM3、细胞周期检查点中的经典CDK1靶点以及p53通路及其他通路中的相关分子之间的相互作用发挥其抗PAAD作用。
